title: Support
intro: Questions or a problem? Write to us and we will get back to you.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: In the app, open Menu and tap Contact support. Please include the id shown at the bottom of Menu so we can find your account.

sections.title: What UniMate is
paragraphs: UniMate helps students find campus services, social links, and news for their university and program. It is an independent student app, not an official university product.
Course content, timetables, and mail stay on university or Microsoft systems. If a campus site is down, contact that service directly.

sections.title: Common help
items: Wrong university or year: open Menu and update Studies, then save.
Notifications: enable them in Menu if you want news alerts.
Privacy and data: see the privacy policy.
